context: A couple wades through tax and benefit forms at home
purpose: Teach: にあたる/氏名/もとより/に関しまして/均等/奨励/分配/遺憾

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ねえ、この申告書、氏名の欄ってフリガナも書くんだっけ？
lines.en: Hey, on this tax form, do we write furigana in the name field too?
lines.style: Mildly frustrated, glancing up from paperwork at the kitchen table

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うん、書いた方が無難だよ。提出期限が今週末にあたるから、今夜中に終わらせたいな。
lines.en: Yeah, safer to write it. The deadline falls on this weekend, so I want to finish tonight.
lines.style: Calm and businesslike, flipping through a thick envelope of forms

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 面倒なのは、もとより覚悟の上って感じだったけど、こんなに書類があるなんてね…。
lines.en: I was prepared for the hassle from the get-go, but I didn't expect this many documents.
lines.style: Half-laughing sigh, leaning her cheek on one hand

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ええと、『児童手当に関しましては』…って書いてあるけどさ、振込口座、君の名義のままでいい？
lines.en: Um, it says 'regarding the child allowance'… anyway, is it fine to leave your name on the account?
lines.style: Reading aloud in mock-formal voice, then dropping back to casual

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん、そのままで。あ、こっちは住民税の均等割の欄、空白でいいのかな？
lines.en: Yes, leave it. Oh, can this per-capita resident tax box stay blank?
lines.style: Slightly anxious, squinting at small print under the lamp

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: そこは記入必須だよ。あとさ、市の子育て奨励金、今年から金額が変わったらしいよ。
lines.en: That one's mandatory. Also, the city's parenting incentive money changed amounts this year apparently.
lines.style: Tone perking up, sliding a pamphlet across the table

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: へえ、増えてるといいね。控除の分配も、夫婦でちゃんと見直さなきゃ。
lines.en: Oh, hope it went up. We should reconsider how we split the deductions too.
lines.style: Brighter and engaged, pulling a calculator closer to her

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 去年は配分ミスって還付が少なかったから、『誠に遺憾の意を表します』って感じだよ。今年は慎重にやろう。
lines.en: Last year we botched the split and got a small refund, so it's like 'I hereby express my deep regret.' Let's be careful this year.
lines.style: Mock-politician voice with a dramatic bow, then chuckling softly

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、大臣みたい。じゃあお茶淹れてくるね、長丁場になりそう。
lines.en: Hehe, you sound like a cabinet minister. I'll go make some tea, this is going to be a long haul.
lines.style: Warm and amused, pushing her chair back to stand up
